summary_xls_comparison.interpretation: Five cached SD results differ only at floating-point last digits; former Sheet1 row 71 SCG-cut entries are absent in the new file. The Cq inputs used for the current six-target/18-comparison analysis are unchanged.

now_supported: Instrument-exported Cq, amplification data, melting data, and curve PNGs are available. The statement that original amplification/melting curves were unavailable should be revised to reflect this newly supplied evidence.
The current Nox1/Nox4 paired Cq table matches all 36 target/reference pairs exactly. All 126 Cq across the complete six-target panel plus beta-actin match the new result-analysis workbook.
The instrument protocol includes an actual melting step from 60 to 95 C in 0.2 C increments, rather than an unrecorded melting step.
not_established: Exports label all active wells Unknown and sample names identify groups only; blank Replicate fields cannot independently establish 6 biological animals versus technical replication. Prior user confirmation remains the biological-n and same-animal-pairing source.
No active NTC, no-RT, standard dilution or validated amplification-efficiency record was identified. No reference-gene stability validation is supplied.
The Melting curve Results setting Max # of peaks=1 limits reported peak count. Zero columns for additional peaks do not prove single-specific-product amplification.
Raw .ord instrument project files are mentioned in paths but not included in the provided directory.
Restoration animals originating in the model cohort does not establish repeated terminal-tissue sampling or justify paired between-cohort inference.

Exact numerical mapping between source wells, summary columns and current CSV has been established. It does not independently establish animal identity or same-animal target/reference pairing; that rests on explicit earlier author confirmation, not raw group-only labels.
requires_resolution: Instrument logs in all three XLSX exports date runs to November 10-11, 2020, while the manuscript gives ethics approval AHUCM-rats-2022032. Actual experiment date, instrument clock correctness and applicable prior approval must be confirmed; do not infer approval coverage from the run timestamp alone.

Plate defines B10-Ch5 (Nox1 model Cq29.82) and D12-Ch5 (Nox4 sham Cq34.69) as Empty/[none], yet Cq Results exports both as SYBR Unknown and includes numeric values. These values are present in the current analysis. Obtain the laboratory explanation/analysis history before deciding whether valid or excluded.

Melt Tm variability needs laboratory review: Nox1 B10-Ch5 has Tm78.59 C while most target wells cluster near72-73 C; Nox1 E11-Ch5 is75.76 C. Nox4 F13-Ch5 is73.98 C while most cluster near79 C; sham D12-Ch5 is77.97 C. These observations alone do not determine contamination or justify retrospective exclusion.

The report retains the contradictory PrimeScript/RevertAid RT wording already discussed and lists TRIzol catalog15596026 rather than the current detailed-method15596018; reconcile with actual reagent records.
